description: Unsafe use of reflection allows loading arbitrary classes at runtime, potentially leading to Remote Code Execution (RCE). User-controlled class names passed to Class.forName() or ClassLoader.loadClass() can be exploited by attackers to instantiate malicious classes and execute arbitrary code. This is a common attack vector in Java applications.

fix_pattern.instructions: Never use user-controlled input directly in Class.forName() or similar reflection methods. Always validate against a strict whitelist of allowed class names. If dynamic loading is required, use a factory pattern with predefined types instead of reflection.
